(p11; justifies max_len = 2).  (i) A connected one-loop graph is 1PI iff every internal line
  +>  lies
on its unique cycle (a line off the cycle is a bridge); hence every vertex of a one-loop 1PI graph
  +>  lies on the cycle
with exactly two internal legs, and all quadratic (kappa^0, two-field) terms are abso
  +> rbed into propagators, so the
graph is a cycle of interaction vertices.  (ii) Every retained interaction
  +>  vertex has coupling order kappa^n, n >= 1
(checked mechanically: the kappa^0 inventory contains only tw
  +> o-field monomials).  (iii) Hence a kappa^order
contribution with order <= 2 has at most `order` <= 2 ver
  +> tices: max_len = 2 is exhaustive.  (iv) The auxiliary b
occurs only in kappa^0 two-field monomials (chec
  +> ked), so its Gaussian elimination produces only bilinear terms
(the de Donder kinetic term and source-bi
  +> linear terms) and no omitted interaction.  (v) Source-linear monomials
(exactly one quantum leg) cannot 
  +> sit on a cycle (two internal legs needed); attached off the cycle they create a
bridge, i.e. a one-parti
  +> cle-reducible graph, so they cannot contribute extra 1PI coefficients.
